Brown side-parted hair, separate dark eyebrows, one stern closed mouth, dark charcoal-brown suit, light pointed collar and dark green tie remain. The near-frontal slight viewer-left pose and short broad collar transition remain. The note has only two upper rows, no third row and largely blank lower paper, and the dark right-edge tab is present. The complete dark tilted frame and opaque dark charcoal/blue-grey backplate remain. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring. The regular dot substitution is the remaining rejection reason.
entries.visible_limitations: Individual beard hairs, fine spectacle rims and exact note glyph identity are not readable at source scale. No extra rejection is based on those uncertainties; the returned marks are visibly regular round dots rather than the source's irregular gray groups.
